t2i_prompt: Flat vector website section styled as a calibration sheet on warm limestone paper with a thin navy border and a small title block at the bottom right. Bold navy headline top-left. A comparison table: a left label column with mono row numbers and bracketed units, then several plan columns separated by thin horizontal rules. One column is outlined in steel-blue with a faint warm tint and a small tab label on top. Under each column a short fits-when note and an outlined button, the highlighted one filled steel-blue. <CONTENT>. No shadows, crisp alignment, generous margins.
signature_idea: A pricing table dressed as a calibration sheet, with one plan outlined like a marked reading.
strengths: easy scan of response times and scope
sheet frame ties to the drawing-set idea
weaknesses: rounded highlight and peach tint break square-corner and palette rules
brand_fit_why: Limestone and navy fit, but rounded corners, a warm tint and SaaS pricing tropes drift from precise and calm.
